approach: Exact fee-on-input quotes centered on a gated fair-price estimate. Only the first callback at a timestamp can update the estimate. The trade must move away from the previous estimate, and its old-fee band-implied price must pass a tolerance of 25 bps times sqrt(max(1, age)) plus the previous accepted relative price jump. Including that jump permits correction after a misclassified retail observation. Otherwise the last inferred price is retained. Bid and ask target spreads start at 10 and 10 bps, respectively, and each widens by 0.1 bps times sqrt(age) since the last accepted observation. Exact bid/ask equations are clamped to [0, 10%]. The policy uses seven of the 32 slots and no history scan, assembly or external calls.

experiment_families.away_jump: First-event direction away from the stored price; consistency tolerance adds the last accepted relative price jump to the age-based gate.
experiment_families.first_event_gate: First-event fee-band consistency gate; otherwise keep the last inferred price.
experiment_families.aligned: First-event direction toward the stored price, combined with the consistency gate.
experiment_families.small: First-event consistency gate plus amountY/reserveY below 5 bps (about 10 bps spot impact).
experiment_families.away: First-event direction away from the stored price, combined with the age-based consistency gate.
experiment_families.reset8: Consistency gate with an unconditional first-event reacquisition after eight steps without an accepted observation.
experiment_families.reverse: Minimum-innovation gate: accept first-event implied-price changes exceeding the age-based threshold.
experiment_families.tree: Shallow arb classifier fitted on 122461 labeled first callbacks from Python diagnostic seeds 0..23; runtime uses observable features only.
experiment_families.regret: First-event decision tree fitted to expected reduction in absolute or squared price-estimation error; hold otherwise.

next: Test a two-hypothesis fair-price filter that retains the previous trusted price alongside the latest observation, allowing rejection of suspected retail reads without blocking later arb corrections.
Condition age uncertainty on the absence of earlier arb callbacks and the quoted no-arbitrage interval; compare that model with the small positive sqrt(age) widening and the zero-width ablation.
Combine this estimator with the strongest independently measured round-one spread/flow policy, then measure its incremental gain over that incumbent on at least 2000 new paired seeds.

repaired_failures: Initial Rust 1.85.1 build failed because ruint 1.21.1 requires Rust 1.90. Installed Rust 1.90.0 inside scratch and rebuilt successfully.
Inline configuration-parity and result-size checks initially could not import the scratch measure module (ModuleNotFoundError); setting PYTHONPATH to the scratch harness directory fixed both checks.
The diagnostic classifier fit summary initially failed to serialize NumPy int64 leaf/depth counts; converting these counts to Python int fixed the report. No strategy or score data was affected.
checked.experiment_restart: The plan7 driver was intentionally interrupted at valid checkpoints and resumed with eight workers after redirecting unstarted experiments to the jump-aware gate. Completed samples were preserved.

selection_rule: Select the highest training mean among policies with positive age widening, as required by this item; promote only after the untouched final comparison clears twice its paired SE.

promotion.criterion: Fresh mean paired gain > 2 * paired standard error.

limitations: Trade identity is not observable exactly: retail can pass the gate and true arbitrage can fail it. A band-implied price is exact only conditional on correct classification.
The square-root aging term is a tuned risk margin, not a calibrated confidence interval; it does not fully exploit the information in an interval without arb callbacks.
Fee floors and the 10% cap can prevent exact centering when spot is far from the estimate.
Results concern the pinned simulator. Public leaderboard scores were not independently replicated, and no leaderboard rank or submission is claimed.
